high_level_description: The image shows two individuals on a motorcycle. The person in the foreground is wearing a black helmet with "West Helmets" written on it. They also have a white scarf with various small drawings, including clouds, hot air balloons, and other whimsical designs, covering their lower face. This individual is also wearing glasses and appears to be smiling or looking directly at the camera. The person in the background is wearing a black and white jacket with a star logo on the chest. They appear to be seated behind the first individual, possibly the driver of the motorcycle.
